title: Fixed High Back Footed Bathtub
description: One original complete freestanding high-back bath appearance. A single closed thick elongated vessel has a deep open interior, full inner and outer floors, continuously rounded sloping sides and a true broad rolled lip rising at one end. Four whole curved splayed metal feet are rooted into its lower belly. A separate complete two-column floor-mounted bridge tap set with finite escutcheons, two fixed controls and one entire arched spout stands beside the low end; one small inner-floor drain cap is a shallow visual detail. No old washbasin, pedestal, cabinet or faucet mesh is imported or rescaled. The low full-length deep bathing vessel and independent floor-supply support route differ from a neck-notched salon bowl on a tall pedestal or a square countertop sink. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up, horizontal envelope centred; one whole prop, zero scenes, no water or people. Static appearance only: no usable plumbing, drainage, water containment, pressure, temperature, bathing ergonomics, support load, installation or safety claim.
